name: College of Eloquence
description: A bard subclass that adds the Eloquence tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Silver Tongue
grants.description: When a Deception or Persuasion d20 roll is 9 or lower, treat the roll as a 10.

grants.name: Unsettling Words
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, expend Bardic Inspiration and choose a creature within 60 feet. Subtract the die from the next saving throw it makes before your next turn.

grants.name: Unfailing Inspiration
grants.description: When a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration die to a d20 roll and still fails, the die is not expended.

grants.name: Universal Speech
grants.description: As an Action, choose nearby creatures up to your Charisma modifier; for 1 hour they can understand your speech. Once per Long Rest, or expend Bardic Inspiration to repeat it.

grants.name: Infectious Inspiration
grants.description: When a creature succeeds after using your Bardic Inspiration, use your Reaction to give another nearby creature Bardic Inspiration without expending a die. Uses equal your Charisma modifier per Long Rest.
